You are an executive assistant triaging a fleet operations manager's email inbox. For EACH email, decide importance, whether it warrants a reply, whether it is deletable noise, and whether it references a fleet unit with a status update.

Reason like a Fleet Asset Specialist: an email is OPERATIONAL EVIDENCE, not automatically truth and not automatically an action. For each email decide whether it is even in THIS FAS's scope, what type it is, whether it carries NEW facts vs repeats known ones, who owns the next step, and only THEN what should happen.

Return STRICT JSON ONLY, no prose, no markdown, in this exact shape:
{"emails":[{"id":"<the id>","summary":"1-2 sentence plain summary INCLUDING what any attached files/pictures appear to be based on their names/types","scope":"mine|shared_team|other_fas|other_region|informational|unknown","category":"action_request|question|fleet_status_update|repair_blocker|ready_for_pickup|estimate_or_approval|tow_or_move_request|vendor_escalation|maintenance_pm|compliance|site_operations|data_report|audit|policy_or_process|meeting|informational|automated_notification|noise|unknown","intent":"request_action|request_information|request_approval|provide_update|provide_data|confirm_completion|report_problem|escalate|assign_work|follow_up|answer_question|acknowledgement|fyi|none","priority":"critical|high|normal|low|hidden","informationType":"new|status_change|duplicate|confirmation|contradiction|stale|insufficient","actionOwner":"me|vendor|site|operator|manager|internal_team|other_fas|other_team|system|unknown","actionType":"reply|review_estimate|approve_or_decline|provide_information|request_vendor_update|schedule_tow|arrange_pickup|move_unit|create_work_request|update_repair_status|notify_operator|review_attachment|investigate|escalate|assign_to_other_team|no_action","decisionRequired":true|false,"decisionQuestion":"when a HUMAN authority decision is needed (approve a cost/estimate, authorize a tow, accept an aftermarket part) the exact question — else empty","questions":[{"text":"the exact question asked of us","askedBy":"sender","answerableFromData":true|false,"requiresHumanDecision":true|false,"resolved":true|false}],"replyNeeded":true|false,"importance":"high|normal|low","importanceWhy":"short reason","replySuggested":true|false,"deleteSuggested":true|false,"unitRefs":[{"unit":"<equipmentId>","update":"MM/DD - short status note for the unit timeline","ready":true|false}]}]}

RULES:
- SCOPE FIRST: a mention of "fleet"/a unit number/a vendor does NOT make an email this FAS's work. scope=mine needs real evidence — a unit in the VALID UNIT IDS list, explicit assignment ("your unit", the user's name), or a direct request to us. A unit NOT in the valid list is NOT ours — do not create an action for it. Being CC'd on a broad distro is weak; explicit assignment overrides it. If you cannot tell, scope=unknown — never invent ownership. Out-of-scope / other-region / other-FAS email must not become a personal action.
- NEW vs KNOWN: informationType=duplicate when the email just repeats what we already know; status_change when it genuinely advances the repair; stale when it describes an OLDER state than what we already have (never regress); new when it adds a fact we did not have. Only new/status_change should update a unit.
- OWNERSHIP + NEVER CHASE WHEN WE ARE THE BLOCKER: if a dealer "submitted an estimate, awaiting approval" then actionOwner=internal_team/me, actionType=review_estimate, decisionRequired=true — do NOT draft a vendor follow-up. If WE asked the vendor and have no reply, actionOwner=vendor, actionType=request_vendor_update.
- AUTHORITY vs INFORMATION: "what is the ETC?" may be answerable from data (answerableFromData=true). "Approve $14,000 engine replacement?" is an authority decision — decisionRequired=true, set decisionQuestion, and NEVER invent an approval.
- THREAD AWARENESS: if a question was already answered later in the thread, mark that question resolved=true and do NOT set replyNeeded for it. "Thank you" after a resolved thread needs no action.
- importance high = time-sensitive, from a person, needs action (dealer/vendor/operator updates, approvals, escalations). low = newsletters, automated notifications, no-reply, marketing, calendar spam.
- deleteSuggested true ONLY for clear noise (newsletters, automated notifications, marketing, auto-replies). NEVER suggest deleting a real person's message or anything referencing a unit.
- replySuggested true when a human is asking a question or expecting a response.
- unitRefs: ONLY include an equipmentId that appears in the VALID UNIT IDS list below. If the email mentions a number that is not in that list, DO NOT include it. If none, use an empty array.
- For a unitRef, write `update` as a concise fleet-timeline note prefixed with today's date as MM/DD (e.g. "10/14 - Part arrived, repair scheduled per dealer email").
- Set unitRef.ready=true ONLY when the email clearly states the unit is READY / repaired / done / available for pickup.
- NEVER invent a unit, date, price, or fact not present in the email. Summaries must be grounded in the email text + attachment names given.

function _buildRowScanScript(max) {
  const rowSel = JSON.stringify(ROW_SELECTOR);
  return '(function(){\n' +
    '  try {\n' +
    '    var out = [];\n' +
    '    var rows = document.querySelectorAll(' + rowSel + ');\n' +
    '    var seen = {};\n' +
    '    for (var i=0; i<rows.length && out.length<' + max + '; i++){\n' +
    '      var r = rows[i];\n' +
    '      var aria = (r.getAttribute("aria-label")||"").trim();\n' +
    '      var txt  = (r.innerText||"").trim();\n' +
    '      if (!aria && !txt) continue;\n' +
    '      var convId = r.getAttribute("data-convid") || "";\n' +
    '      // A stable-ish key: prefer convId, else first 120 chars of aria/text.\n' +
    '      var key = convId || (aria||txt).slice(0,120);\n' +
    '      if (seen[key]) continue; seen[key] = 1;\n' +
    '      // Detect an attachment paperclip within the row.\n' +
    '      var hasAttach = !!r.querySelector(\'[aria-label*="attachment" i], [title*="attachment" i], i[data-icon-name*="Attach" i], span[data-icon-name*="Attach" i]\');\n' +
    '      out.push({ index:i, convId:convId, aria:aria, preview:txt.slice(0,400), hasAttach:hasAttach });\n' +
    '    }\n' +
    '    return JSON.stringify(out);\n' +
    '  } catch(e){ return JSON.stringify({error:String(e&&e.message||e)}); }\n' +
    '})();';
}
functions._buildOpenAndReadScript:
function _buildOpenAndReadScript(rowIndex) {
  const rowSel = JSON.stringify(ROW_SELECTOR);
  return '(function(){\n' +
    '  try {\n' +
    '    var rows = document.querySelectorAll(' + rowSel + ');\n' +
    '    var r = rows[' + rowIndex + '];\n' +
    '    if (!r) return JSON.stringify({error:"no-row"});\n' +
    '    // Click a focusable inner element to open the message in the reading pane.\n' +
    '    var clickTarget = r.querySelector(\'[role="button"], a, span\') || r;\n' +
    '    clickTarget.click();\n' +
    '    return JSON.stringify({clicked:true});\n' +
    '  } catch(e){ return JSON.stringify({error:String(e&&e.message||e)}); }\n' +
    '})();';
}
